selector.why: The presence of scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining, along with the patient's history of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma and lytic lesions in the calvarium, strongly supports the diagnosis of Amyloidosis.
